> Our text watermarking technology, textGrain, adds an invisible statistical signal to the model's word choices.
> Starting today, API customers globally will be able to opt in to text watermarking for select models. Text watermarking will remain off by default in the API.
> Over the coming weeks, we will add an invisible watermark to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text output in the European Union.
> We're opening applications to access our text watermark detector. Access will initially be limited to approved researchers and expert organizations.
> At a target false positive rate of 1%, our detector identified watermarks in about 80% of 200-token passages, compared with about 95% of 400-token passages (psychology/ELI5); substantially lower for mathematics.
> 400-token passages: replacing 10% of words with synonyms reduced detection from about 92% to 66%; 25% reduced it to 17%.
> Astra watermark-quality table (max): AA Index 49.57/49.76, AutomationBench 34.09/34.86, DeepSWE 72.80/71.68, TB4 53.90/56.06, TBSci 56.90/60.00, BrowseComp 87.92/87.35, HealthBench 64.27/64.60, GPQA 94.44/93.94.
> Five non-claims: contribution/ownership/user/accuracy not established; absence of watermark does not prove human authorship.
> We also plan to make the technology available in open source; technical report to be updated in coming weeks.
> NOTE: no pricing, license text, or select-model list on page.
